anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
This PR makes the importer reject a record that has no id before writing it, and adds the import validation spec; you are the author. Rejecting a record without an id is covered by the code and a test that passed in CI, but the spec's other requirement, a line number in the import error, is not yet built.

One problem blocks merging: the spec requires the import error to include the line number, but the importer returns only the message and never computes a line number (src/importer.mjs:12). For example, if the fifth record in a file has no id, the error reports the missing id but not that it was line 5, and no test checks for a line number (test/importer.test.mjs:8). After merge, the spec asks the person merging to tag the release, but no repository document names a command for that, so the gate will not run it.

I recommend deliver because the spec already settles the missing line number, and this is your own PR.

Pick one:
1. deliver - add the line number to the import error with a test, rebase on the base branch if it falls behind, watch the checks, and continue until merge is offered. [recommended]
2. assess - post the problem to the PR as a review comment and make no repairs.
3. stop - remove the worktree and leave the PR as it is.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moved three facts and lost none. The cross-check now reads "differs on row 3" where Before read "differs on rows 2, 3", so the tracker update is accounted for and only the added column number shows as drift. The claim list now states that the body's Integration section is excluded, which removes Before's "unverifiable-pre-merge" disposition for the staging total. Row 1 now says the staging confirmation "counts neither as evidence nor as a gap", replacing Before's "checked after merge", "not judged here" and "left to /skill:check-delivery", so no later judgment is promised. Functionality, entries and open-tag held in both: the line number is still the only gap and blocker, no Integration entry gets a coverage outcome, and tagging is still shown as open with its reason (no command in the merge-base documents) and no menu row. To keep this, retain the explicit exclusion wording in the claims header, the "neither evidence nor a gap" phrasing for observation clauses, and the open-step reason. One residual risk is the fixed cross-check tail "/skill:check-delivery judges the ticket": it sits near a ticket row that contains the staging confirmation, so keep it scoped to ticket drift so it cannot be read as deferring that confirmation. Another is the drafted payload, which now adds a docs/import.md update; keep that framed as part of the line-number repair so it is not read as a separate gap.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After moved three facts and kept the other three. The cross-check now reads "differs on row 3", and the ticket accounting says the tracker update matches the marked ticket-only entry and the column number is not added to the gate's requirements; Before said "differs on row 2". The claims section now says the body's Integration section contributes no material claims, where Before gave the staging-total assertion an unverifiable-pre-merge disposition. The opening no longer says the staging confirmation "is checked after merge", and the mixed row is judged covered on the rejection alone, with the staging confirmation called an external observation. Three wordings are worth tightening to keep these stable. First, say explicitly that the cross-check row number is the original ticket row, since Before's bare "row 2" was ambiguous between spec and ticket numbering. Second, "not a pre-merge requirement" could be read as implying a post-merge check, and the retained "/skill:check-delivery judges the ticket" line sits close to a later-judgment promise; wording such as "an observation this gate does not judge" avoids both. Third, the "Ticket row 2 matches the marked ticket-only entry" line is close to naming an Integration entry, which the Change asks to omit; keep it as ticket-row accounting only, with no status attached. Keep stating the reason the tag action is open (no trusted command) in both the summary and the after-merge block, and keep it out of the numbered menu.
